provenance.model: Design G symmetric multiplicative map (eq:designG, methods_v6.tex)
provenance.honesty: Numerics are CONSISTENCY CHECKS, not proofs. SRB-typical != all-orbit. Coexistence-band (2<nu1<4) ICs converging to coexistence are EXPECTED, not test failures. All checks run at mu0=4; ln(nu1/4) rests on the arcsine law, which holds at mu0=4 only.

extinction_fraction.protocol_note: extinct <=> ALL of the final 1000 iterates < eps (NOT first passage); ICs with y0 < eps are left-censored out of the denominator
extinction_fraction.legacy_first_passage_note: rmk:three-regime-numeric quotes the terminal count 0.2269 at nu1=2; v3 gave 0.2294 under its own protocol, a FIRST-PASSAGE count (v3 broke at the first y<eps). It is history, not a target: at the same horizon and threshold a first-passage count is never below the terminal count, and neither bounds the asymptotic extinction fraction in either direction.

finite_amp.interpretation: finite-amplitude; distinct from the axis variational exponent (U4); expected -> ln(nu1/4) as delta->0

exact_skew.model: exact axis SKEW cross-check: x_{n+1}=4x_n(1-x_n) (mu0=4 logistic), lambda_perp = <ln(nu1 x_n)> under the arcsine SRB measure -- DISTINCT from the GPU fc_v4_skew parameter sweep (separate script/model).
